rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L185 Artefact-contracts table, M6 consuming cell: "M6 (no body line names it; the handoff prompt authors further skills after the module)". This is the exact line the diff (191ea58f..HEAD) rewrote, replacing a now-false claim about a 'Composing the workflow' kit. The replacement pairs a present-tense negative ('no body line names it') with the positive fact right beside it ('the handoff prompt authors further skills'). Per the rule's own test — 'is the positive fact already stated nearby?' — yes, in the same clause, so the negative half is the redundant phantom the 2026-09-05 addendum names ('traces of what should not exist and we say that should not exist'), not a needed do-not-reintroduce licence (nothing is being guarded against re-adding). Harm: a reader gets no information from the negative half; it only exists because the OLD (false) claim got fixed by negating it rather than by just stating what IS true.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Drop 'no body line names it; ' and state only the positive consuming fact: 'M6 (the handoff prompt authors further skills after the module)'.
